clips.title: The story
paras: Bruuz threatens the harbor traffic that keeps Ratchet busy. Gazlowe has posted a bounty for the huge shark prowling the docks and disrupting coastal trade.

Ratchet is the primary neutral gateway between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, and its trade depends on merchant ships. Lately, a huge shark called Bruuz has been prowling the bay. Dockworkers gave the shark its name after it began attacking small skiffs, sailors, and cargo being unloaded near the docks. Its presence disrupts the port and puts the ships that keep Ratchet supplied at risk.

Gazlowe has posted a public bounty to keep ships from avoiding his port for fear of the shark. The notice calls on anglers and promises a hefty reward. To claim it, you need to slay Bruuz and bring back the shark's dorsal fin as proof.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

clips.title: Progress
paras: What can I do for ya, traveler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Finally, somebody killed that thing! Do you know how hard it is to get a crew in the water when everyone in town's crying "Shark!" all the time?
I might just put that monster's fin into a soup for dinner tonight, just to have the last laugh.
